reviewMethod: Actual original-resolution Game View pixels inspected with view_image for each of the seven current files.

checkedImages.observations: Ranger full body and quest marker are clear. Crates, raised herb garden, trail sign and reading bench are four separate visible memories; none is stacked or hidden behind a productive facade.
Stationkeeper is clear beside the path. Lantern, supply crates, reading bench and produce stall are distinct; the stall sits beside the warehouse while its awning and display remain visible.

Baker face and bread basket are readable. Crates, herb garden and produce stall remain distinct. The chapter-four bread cart now shows bread, canopy and wheels on the left grass instead of disappearing behind the lower house; rowan leaves touch its right edge.

Mechanic is clear on the path. Pump, crates, learning bench and chapter-four lantern are all recognizable. The moved lantern is fully visible on the left grass; foliage touches the bench roof and crate lower edge without hiding either memory.

Historian and album are visible between the houses. Crates stand just right of her feet and the sign beside her; the reading structure and bench are recognizable lower in the lane, followed by the separate rowan. Small leaves touch the bench roof but no memory is buried behind the productive house facade.
Musician and violin remain unobstructed. Lantern, reading bench, tea patio and flower bed occupy separate open grass positions above and beside her, clear of the existing rowan.

Guide and walking staff are fully visible. Picnic nook, lantern and trail sign remain separated; the moved chapter-four rowan is fully recognizable to the left of the path, away from the right birch canopy.
